priorities.summary: Opt-in sidecar-owned durable process stdin/stdout/stderr reattaches across native-agent restart; bounded output spool and Windows/Linux CI coverage
Verified task-graph artifact metadata/hashes persist in checkpoints without artifact contents
Persistent device directory, aliases, groups, capability-aware discovery, deterministic named route policies, and multi-device routing are implemented

Native protocol v2 identifies process instances; same-process reconnects resume exact request IDs through bounded dedupe cache, read-only work may resume after process restart, and pending mutations fail unknown instead of replaying across instance change
First-party relay server, ordered direct/relay endpoint fallback, inbound/upstream authentication, bounded forwarding/backpressure/heartbeats, and real native-agent relay CI are implemented
Per-device capability policies, a separate elevated Windows broker, DPAPI CurrentUser-protected broker authentication, and highest-privilege per-user scheduled-task lifecycle are implemented

Direct TLS, rotating bootstrap bearer credentials, revocable/expiring hash-only stored credentials, MCP tool/device/deterministic-route scopes, and explicit stored-credential admin grants are implemented; deployment-grade identity, protected secret handling, and stronger operator/admin identity remain
Stored credential authorization filters tools/list and calls, and HTTP MCP discovery also filters native-backed schemas by the union of capabilities advertised by online Nexowire agents
Reusable bounded read-only file/process/TCP/HTTP postcondition assertion workflows are implemented
Real Linux native-agent outbound transport/core capability and real relay fallback integration run in Ubuntu CI; real WSL2 distro integration remains open
Bounded persistent payload-free audit history query with capability/status/target/provider/operation/time filters
Durable process sessions and task-graph artifact metadata are implemented; higher-level resumable long-running workflows and artifact lifecycle remain

Broad first-party MCP surface plus credential-aware and online-capability-aware discovery are implemented; remaining stabilization is mainly deployment-grade authorization/identity and long-running workflow maturity
